propositions: autodeploy recreates the review-bot container without draining in-flight reviews, killing reviews mid-execution when main advances and bot source changes
a landing burst with deploy gaps shorter than review duration causes the llm-review gate to live-lock: reviews are killed before voting, blocking all submissions
the reconciler retry path is unprotected by the shutdown queue drain, allowing killed reviews to be killed again on retry, perpetuating the lock
no alarm fires during gate live-lock because killed reviews emit no voter_error; the bot reports healthy despite zero voting
autodeploy now defers deployment if a review is in-flight, deferring up to 1800s (keyed to episode not sha) until the bot becomes idle or timeout expires
deferred deploys and review interrupts are now counted and alarmed separately to restore observability of the previously-blind failure mode
